command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged input against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' b4d4d74594d6213f26dfbd8eeb194ae9a9eaf6c529242384a7395bb56c7c7294 \
  pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== raxml-ng --search: adaptive ML tree search, LG+G4, fixed seed =="
# The search is left on its RAxML-NG 2.0 default (start tree "adaptive"): the tool
# predicts the difficulty of the alignment and picks the number and kind of starting
# trees from it. That default is the thing worth demonstrating, so it is not overridden.
#
# --threads 8 --workers 1, not the default AUTO: the thread count feeds the parallel
# parsimony that the difficulty prediction is computed from, so it decides how many
# starting trees the adaptive heuristic generates. Pinning it, together with --seed,
# is what makes this run comparable to the next one. --model is given explicitly
# rather than inferred for the same reason.
raxml-ng --search --msa pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa --model LG+G4 \
  --threads 8 --workers 1 --seed 12345 --prefix rx --redo

# ---- smoke check ----
# Almost all of this is arithmetic RAxML-NG must satisfy to be self-consistent at all,
# not a band on an observed value. Three information criteria it prints are closed-form
# functions of the log-likelihood, the free-parameter count and the site count it also
# prints, and the free-parameter count is itself fixed by the taxon count and the model:
# an unrooted binary tree on n taxa has 2n-3 branches, and LG+G4 adds exactly one free
# parameter (the gamma shape alpha), so k must be 2n-2. Those cannot go flaky and need
# no headroom. Likewise --search means "report the best of the searches", so the final
# log-likelihood must equal the maximum over the per-search values, exactly; and the
# tool must write exactly one ML tree and one starting tree per search it reports.
#
# There is no python3 in this image (one tool per image, deliberately), so the checks
# are awk. The only banded value is the log-likelihood itself, and it is banded wide
# on purpose -- see the README.
NSEARCH=$(grep -c 'ML tree search #' rx.raxml.log)
# One Newick per line, each terminated by ';'.
NMLTREES=$(grep -c ';' rx.raxml.mlTrees)
NSTART=$(grep -c ';' rx.raxml.startTree)
NTAX_IN=$(grep -c '^>' pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa)
NTIPS=$(grep -oE '[(,][A-Za-z0-9_]+:' rx.raxml.bestTree | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SEMICOLON=$(tail -c 2 rx.raxml.bestTree | tr -d '\n')
# RAxML-NG writes this line only after the whole analysis completes cleanly, so it is a
# completion sentinel: a search killed part-way leaves a log whose per-search lines and
# tree files would still look plausible.
# `|| true` on these three: a count of 0 is the interesting answer, and grep -c exits 1
# when it counts nothing, which under `set -e` would kill the task before the table
# below prints. A red row beats a bare exit.
FINISHED=$(grep -c '^Analysis started: .* / finished: ' rx.raxml.log || true)
# The optimised model must still be LG+G4m over all 477 sites of the one partition --
# evidence --model was honoured and no site was dropped.
MODEL_OK=$(grep -cF 'LG+G4m{' rx.raxml.bestModel || true)
SITES_OK=$(grep -cF '= 1-477' rx.raxml.bestModel || true)

awk -v nsearch="$NSEARCH" -v nmltrees="$NMLTREES" -v nstart="$NSTART" \
    -v ntax_in="$NTAX_IN" -v ntips="$NTIPS" -v semi="$SEMICOLON" \
    -v finished="$FINISHED" -v model_ok="$MODEL_OK" -v sites_ok="$SITES_OK" '
/^Final LogLikelihood:/            { L = $NF }
/^AIC score:/                      { aic = $3; aicc = $7; bic = $11 }
/^Free parameters/                 { k = $NF }
/Loaded alignment with/            { ntax = $(NF-4); nsites = $(NF-1) }
/^Alignment sites \/ patterns:/    { npatt = $NF }
/ML tree search #/                 { v = $NF + 0; if (best == "" || v > best) best = v }
function check(label, ok, detail) {
  printf "%-28s %s\n", label, detail
  if (!ok) fail = fail (fail ? ", " : "") label
}
END {
  # --- shape, straight from the pinned alignment, so exact ---
  check("taxa_in_alignment", ntax_in == 114, ntax_in "  want exactly 114")
  check("taxa_read_by_raxml", ntax == ntax_in, ntax "  want exactly " ntax_in " (= taxa in the FASTA)")
  check("tips_in_best_tree", ntips == ntax_in, ntips "  want exactly " ntax_in " (every taxon present)")
  check("alignment_sites", nsites == 477, nsites "  want exactly 477")
  check("distinct_site_patterns", npatt == 465 && npatt <= nsites,
        npatt "  want exactly 465, and <= " nsites)

  # --- identities: closed-form, no tolerance needed beyond float printing ---
  check("free_parameters", k == 2 * ntax - 2,
        k "  want exactly " 2 * ntax - 2 " (= 2n-3 branches + 1 gamma alpha)")
  e = 2 * k - 2 * L
  check("aic_identity", (aic - e < 1e-4 && e - aic < 1e-4),
        aic "  want 2k-2lnL = " sprintf("%.6f", e))
  if (nsites - k - 1 > 0) {
    e = aic + 2 * k * (k + 1) / (nsites - k - 1)
    check("aicc_identity", (aicc - e < 1e-4 && e - aicc < 1e-4),
          aicc "  want AIC+2k(k+1)/(n-k-1) = " sprintf("%.6f", e))
  } else {
    check("aicc_identity", 0, "n-k-1 = " nsites - k - 1 "  want > 0")
  }
  e = k * log(nsites) - 2 * L
  check("bic_identity", (bic - e < 1e-4 && e - bic < 1e-4),
        bic "  want k*ln(n)-2lnL = " sprintf("%.6f", e))
  check("final_is_best_of_searches", (L - best < 1e-6 && best - L < 1e-6),
        L "  want exactly the best of the " nsearch " searches (" sprintf("%.6f", best) ")")

  # --- conservation: one ML tree and one starting tree per reported search ---
  check("ml_trees_vs_searches", nmltrees == nsearch,
        nmltrees "  want exactly " nsearch " (one per reported search)")
  check("start_trees_vs_searches", nstart == nsearch,
        nstart "  want exactly " nsearch " (one per reported search)")

  # --- completion and syntax ---
  check("raxml_reported_finished", finished == 1, finished "  want exactly 1")
  check("newick_terminated", semi == ";", semi "  want exactly ;")
  check("model_is_LG+G4m", model_ok == 1, model_ok "  want exactly 1 (bestModel says LG+G4m{alpha})")
  check("all_sites_in_partition", sites_ok == 1, sites_ok "  want exactly 1 (bestModel says = 1-477)")

  # --- the one band, deliberately wide; see the README ---
  check("best_log_likelihood", L > -54000 && L < -52000,
        L "  want -54000..-52000  (observed -52706.731409; IQ-TREE: -52706.731)")

  if (fail != "") { print "FAILED: " fail; exit 1 }
}' rx.raxml.log > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
cat smoke-check.txt

test -s rx.raxml.bestTree
test -s rx.raxml.mlTrees
test -s rx.raxml.bestModel
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
